prompt:
Top-down editorial still photograph, bright and airy. A single sheet of matte white paper lies flat on a seamless pure white paper backdrop, slightly rotated. Sunlight passes through an unseen glass prism from the upper left and casts a vivid, crisp rainbow spectrum band and a few soft prismatic flares diagonally across the backdrop and one corner of the sheet, leaving the printed text clear and readable.
The sheet is an operations agent test report, an evaluation dashboard of test cases, built in AI & Agents Advanced. It shows only the artifact's own content, never a caption or description of what it is, printed in clean modern sans-serif typography, near-black ink, generous margins and a clear hierarchy. Visible text, spelled exactly: "Golden set · 40 cases"; "Passed 37"; "Needs review 3". The "Needs review 3" figure is set in bold.
Nothing else in the frame: no hands, no people, no desk, no pens, no plants, no devices, no props, no logos. The prism itself is out of frame. Clean, bright, high-end.
